findings.title: 1 terminal API failure — infrastructure delay, not session behavior
findings.description: The API returned transient errors during this session. 1 request failed terminally and was replaced by a synthetic error placeholder. This delay originated from provider-side availability, not from anything the user or the agent did, and must not count against the session. This finding contextualizes wall-clock numbers in other findings rather than flagging a problem to fix.

recommendation.rationale: Transient API errors are provider-side and outside the session's control; no configuration change is required. If large operations repeatedly hit overload errors, consider re-running them off-peak. Primarily, use this finding to discount the retry wait time when reading other findings in this report.
